items.headline: AI now shows up in over half of Hacker News 'Who is Hiring?' posts
items.summary: A tracker found AI mentioned in 51.6% of November's hiring posts, up from 30% two years ago, while the total number of posts is at its lowest yearly average since 2013.
items.why: Fewer jobs overall, but more of them ask for AI experience. Being able to talk about how you use AI is now a real differentiator.

items.headline: An Anthropic hiring manager drops the traditional coding interview
items.summary: Felix Rieseberg wrote that he no longer uses traditional coding interviews for his team, because AI models now outperform people at coding tasks. He has not settled on a replacement.
items.why: One manager, not company policy, and big tech still runs coding rounds. But it shows where things are heading: more weight on judgment, design and working with AI.
